title: WebEvolver: Enhancing Web Agent Self-Improvement with Co-evolving World Model
authors_zh: Tianqing Fang、Hongming Zhang、Zhisong Zhang、Kaixin Ma、Wenhao Yu、Haitao Mi、Dong Yu
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: WebEvolver co-trains Llama-3.3-70B policy and world models, releases policy and world-model SFT message data, and uses synthetic rollouts plus world-model look-ahead; raw trajectories and replay metadata are not released.
WebEvolver 联合训练 Llama-3.3-70B 的策略模型与世界模型，发布了两者的监督微调消息数据，并使用合成采样与世界模型前瞻；原始轨迹与回放元数据未发布。
why: It makes a world model both a training-data generator and an inference-time search component, creating a useful rollout-data case whose released SFT boundary must be kept separate from the paper's unreleased trajectory pipeline.
inclusion_reason: Releases policy and world-model SFT corpora and documents a co-evolution recipe that converts live web interaction into accepted real and synthetic training examples, while leaving raw trajectory provenance and replay artifacts unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html: WebEvolver was published at EMNLP 2025 and addresses stagnation in web-agent self-improvement when a policy repeatedly trains on its own successful live-web trajectories but explores too little and does not exploit knowledge already encoded in the LLM. Its paper-level data object is a sequence of queries, accessibility-tree observations, chain-of-thought/action decisions, completion judgments, and world-model-generated next observations. Its released object is narrower: Hugging Face exposes two JSONL SFT files for the agent policy and world model, represented as chat messages, rather than the raw real/synthetic trajectories, rejected attempts, or replayable browser states. This distinction makes the work relevant to rollout_search_test_time_trace_data: multiple real and imagined rollouts shape training and WMLA action selection, but only their SFT serialization is reusable from the official data release.

WebEvolver 发表于 EMNLP 2025，所处理的问题是：Web agent 反复用自身在真实网页上完成的成功轨迹进行训练时，可能因探索不足、未充分利用 LLM 预训练阶段获得的网页知识而停止改进。论文层面的数据对象包括 query、accessibility-tree observation、chain-of-thought/action 决策、完成度判断，以及 world model 生成的下一步 observation；但公开对象更窄，Hugging Face 只提供 agent policy 与 world model 的两个 JSONL SFT 文件，并以聊天 messages 表示，而不是原始真实/合成轨迹、被拒绝尝试或可重放浏览器状态。正是这一边界使它与 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 相关：多条真实与想象 rollout 影响训练和 WMLA 动作选择，但官方数据发布中可复用的只有其 SFT 序列化结果。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The method co-trains a Llama-3.3-70B policy and a Llama-3.3-70B world model. Accepted live-browser trajectories supervise the policy and are converted into transition examples in which the world model predicts the next accessibility-tree observation from the recent observation/action history and a base-model-generated transition rationale. The iteration-2 world model then acts as a virtual web server: alternating its predicted observations with actions from the iteration-1 policy produces up-to-seven-step synthetic trajectories for queries not solved during real self-improvement, and successful synthetic trajectories are added to policy SFT. Separately, WMLA uses the world model to simulate candidate actions at inference time and lets GPT-4o score predicted progress. Training acceptance is therefore a Llama-3.3-70B binary judgment, live execution supplies environmental feedback, and WMLA uses a GPT-4o scalar judge; none is a programmatic proof of correctness.

该方法共同训练一个 Llama-3.3-70B policy 和一个 Llama-3.3-70B world model。通过完成度筛选的真实浏览器轨迹既监督 policy，也会被转换为 transition example：world model 根据最近的 observation/action 历史及由 base model 生成的 transition rationale，预测下一棵 accessibility tree。随后，iteration-2 world model 充当虚拟 web server，与 iteration-1 policy 的动作交替生成最长七步的 synthetic trajectory，目标是处理真实自我改进阶段未完成的 query；通过完成度筛选的合成轨迹再加入 policy SFT。WMLA 是另一条独立的推理时分支，它用 world model 模拟候选动作，并由 GPT-4o 评价预测进展。因此，训练数据接收依赖 Llama-3.3-70B 的二元判断，真实执行提供 environmental feedback，WMLA 使用 GPT-4o scalar judge；三者都不是程序化正确性证明。

title: Method
方法
html: Training starts from 1,516 queries drawn from the Mind2Web training set and self-instructed queries for websites represented in WebVoyager and Mind2Web. Cognitive Kernel operates a Playwright browser over live websites using accessibility-tree observations and click, type, scroll, goback, restart, and stop actions; interaction terminates at completion or a step limit. Llama-3.3-70B samples trajectories and also supplies binary completion judgments for rejection sampling. Successful examples accumulate across three reported self-improvement iterations and are optimized with ordinary SFT, not end-to-end RL. Real trajectories are also converted into world-model examples, with the original Llama-3.3-70B supplying transition rationales. Synthetic generation alternates the iteration-2 world model and iteration-1 policy for at most seven steps and filters the result again. At inference, WMLA samples up to three candidate actions: the first at temperature 0 and alternatives at 0.7 with a diversity instruction, then simulates depths one to three and selects the highest GPT-4o score. The official repository provides scripts for sampling and conversion, but per-query rollout counts, accepted counts, training-time temperature, full fine-tuning settings, and checkpoints remain unknown.

训练从 1,516 个 query 开始，其来源是 Mind2Web training set，以及面向 WebVoyager 和 Mind2Web 所含网站的 self-instructed queries。Cognitive Kernel 通过 Playwright 操作真实网站，以 accessibility tree 为 observation，动作空间包括 click、type、scroll、goback、restart 和 stop；交互在任务完成或达到 step limit 时终止。Llama-3.3-70B 既采样轨迹，也为 rejection sampling 提供二元完成度判断。成功样本在论文报告的三轮 self-improvement 中累积，并用常规 SFT 优化，而不是 end-to-end RL。真实轨迹还被转换为 world-model example，transition rationale 由原始 Llama-3.3-70B 提供。合成阶段让 iteration-2 world model 与 iteration-1 policy 交替生成，最多七步，并再次筛选结果。推理阶段的 WMLA 最多采样三个候选动作：第一个使用 temperature 0，其他动作使用 0.7 并附加差异化指令；随后模拟一至三层深度，由 GPT-4o 最高分决定执行动作。官方仓库提供采样与转换脚本，但逐 query rollout 数、接收数量、训练采样温度、完整 fine-tuning 设置和 checkpoint 仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html: ACL Anthology verifies the EMNLP 2025 paper, authors, pages 8959-8975, and DOI; arXiv links the Tencent repository. The official Hugging Face release declares MIT, shows one train split of about 13.5k rows with a single messages feature, and contains webevolver_policy_sft.jsonl (23.9 MB) plus webevolver_world_model_sft.jsonl (76.2 MB); the accepted metadata records 13,465 combined SFT rows. In the paper, WebEvolver reaches 42.49 on the 473-query text-only WebVoyager set versus 32.98 for the zero-shot Llama-3.3-70B agent, while WMLA at depth two reaches 51.37; experiments are also reported on a filtered 53-query Mind2Web-Live set, GAIA-web, and SimpleQA. The world-model evaluation reports declining structural, similarity, and overall scores beyond depth two. These results support the recipe under the tested models, filtered websites, judges, and time window; they do not show that every released SFT row, synthetic state, or self-judgment is correct, and benchmark performance is not evidence of data quality.

ACL Anthology 核验了 EMNLP 2025 论文、作者、页码 8959-8975 和 DOI，arXiv 则链接到 Tencent 官方仓库。官方 Hugging Face 发布声明 MIT，展示一个约 13.5k 行、只有 messages feature 的 train split，并包含 webevolver_policy_sft.jsonl（23.9 MB）与 webevolver_world_model_sft.jsonl（76.2 MB）；已接受元数据记录两者合计 13,465 条 SFT row。论文中，WebEvolver 在含 473 个 query 的 text-only WebVoyager 上得到 42.49，而 zero-shot Llama-3.3-70B agent 为 32.98；depth two 的 WMLA 达到 51.37。论文还在过滤后的 53-query Mind2Web-Live、GAIA-web 和 SimpleQA 上报告实验。World-model evaluation 显示，深度超过二以后，structure、similarity 和 overall score 均下降。这些结果只支持该配方在所测试模型、过滤网站、judge 和时间窗口下的表现，不能证明每条公开 SFT row、synthetic state 或 self-judgment 都正确；benchmark performance 也不是数据质量证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: WebEvolver does not introduce iterative SFT, rejection sampling, web-agent world models, or look-ahead scoring in isolation. Relative to OpenWebVoyager-style self-improvement, its specific change is to co-evolve a transition-predicting LLM from the same interaction loop and use that model both to manufacture additional policy-training trajectories and to simulate candidate actions at inference. Relative to WebDreamer and WMA, the paper emphasizes that its world model participates in training-data construction and produces up-to-seven-step synthetic rollouts, rather than serving only as a static one- or short-horizon prompting component. For this Track, the useful novelty is the shared lineage across real rollout, judged acceptance, world-model SFT, synthetic rollout, second acceptance, and policy SFT. That lineage is described in the paper and partially implemented in code, but the released SFT files do not carry a manifest that makes every stage auditable per row.

WebEvolver 并未分别发明 iterative SFT、rejection sampling、web-agent world model 或 look-ahead scoring。相较于 OpenWebVoyager 风格的自我改进，它的具体变化是：在同一交互循环中共同演化一个预测 transition 的 LLM，并让该模型同时承担额外 policy-training trajectory 的生成器和推理时候选动作模拟器。相较于 WebDreamer 与 WMA，论文强调其 world model 会参与训练数据构造，并生成最长七步的 synthetic rollout，而不只是静态的一步或短视野 prompting 组件。对本 Track 而言，真正有用的新意是把 real rollout、judged acceptance、world-model SFT、synthetic rollout、第二次 acceptance 与 policy SFT 串成同一 lineage。论文描述了这条 lineage，代码也实现了其中一部分，但公开 SFT 文件没有提供可逐 row 审计各阶段的 manifest。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The release boundary prevents full replay or provenance audit: the two SFT JSONL files do not include raw live trajectories, rejected rollouts, per-iteration/query mappings, timestamps, captured browser state, model checkpoints, or a row-level real-versus-synthetic manifest. Llama-3.3-70B judges its own training successes without reported calibration or human agreement, so false acceptance and false rejection can be amplified through later SFT. A language-model world model can hallucinate web state, and the paper's intrinsic scores fall below 0.50 beyond depth two; the authors argue that noise may diversify training, but do not establish item-level correctness. Live websites change, 48 Mind2Web and five WebVoyager sites are excluded for access reasons, and experiments are repeated only in roughly aligned time windows. The dataset and code declare MIT, but rights or consent for third-party web content embedded in message text, decontamination, duplicate controls, and evaluation-query overlap are unknown. GPT-4o evaluation and WMLA scoring also introduce an external judge distinct from the self-improvement loop.

公开边界使完整重放与 provenance audit 无法实现：两个 SFT JSONL 文件没有提供原始 live trajectory、rejected rollout、逐 iteration/query 映射、timestamp、捕获的 browser state、model checkpoint，或逐 row 的 real-versus-synthetic manifest。Llama-3.3-70B 在没有报告 calibration 或 human agreement 的情况下判断自身训练轨迹是否成功，因此 false acceptance 与 false rejection 可能通过后续 SFT 被放大。语言模型 world model 会产生虚构网页状态，论文的 intrinsic score 在深度超过二以后低于 0.50；作者认为噪声可能增加训练多样性，但并未证明条目级正确性。真实网站会变化，实验因访问问题排除了 48 个 Mind2Web 网站和五个 WebVoyager 网站，重复实验也只是尽量安排在相近时间窗口。Dataset 与 code 声明 MIT，但 message text 所含第三方网页内容的权利或同意、decontamination、duplicate control 与 evaluation-query overlap 均为 unknown。GPT-4o evaluation 与 WMLA scoring 还引入了一个不同于自我改进循环的外部 judge。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For rollout_search_test_time_trace_data, WebEvolver is useful as a schema and audit case for a two-branch trajectory system. A reproducible record would retain query and website provenance, timestamped accessibility trees, policy thoughts/actions, termination reason, Llama completion judgment and rationale, iteration, acceptance status, world-model transition rationale and prediction, real-versus-synthetic flag, WMLA candidate action, simulated depth, GPT-4o score, and model/checkpoint identifiers. Such records could support SFT mixture studies, selector and judge audits, world-model drift analysis, rejected-rollout research, and replay under frozen browser snapshots. The current official release directly supports policy and world-model SFT, while the paper supports agent training and test-time look-ahead. It does not make raw trajectories, rejected samples, checkpoints, or replay environments reusable, and downstream users should not convert the reported benchmark gains into quality labels for the released rows.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 而言，WebEvolver 可作为“双分支 trajectory system”的 schema 与审计案例。一条可复现记录应保留 query 与 website provenance、带 timestamp 的 accessibility tree、policy thought/action、termination reason、Llama completion judgment 及 rationale、iteration、acceptance status、world-model transition rationale 与 prediction、real-versus-synthetic flag、WMLA candidate action、simulation depth、GPT-4o score，以及 model/checkpoint identifier。此类记录可用于 SFT mixture 研究、selector 与 judge 审计、world-model drift 分析、rejected-rollout 研究和 frozen browser snapshot 上的重放。当前官方发布直接支持 policy 与 world-model SFT，论文则支持 agent training 和 test-time look-ahead；它并未使原始轨迹、被拒样本、checkpoint 或 replay environment 可复用，下游用户也不应把报告的 benchmark gain 转换成公开 row 的质量标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the Hugging Face artifact as two SFT message corpora, not as the paper's raw real and synthetic trajectory collection.
  • Keep the judges separate: Llama-3.3-70B filters training trajectories, GPT-4o evaluates benchmarks and scores WMLA rollouts, and live execution provides environmental outcomes.
  • Synthetic training uses the iteration-2 world model with the iteration-1 policy, is restricted to previously unsuccessful queries, and stops after at most seven steps.
  • WMLA samples up to three actions with temperatures 0 and 0.7, simulates depths one to three, and is an inference-time procedure rather than released training data.
  • Check for row-level lineage, rejected attempts, timestamps, browser snapshots, decontamination, checkpoints, and third-party web-content rights before claiming replayability or broad reuse.

• 应把 Hugging Face artifact 视为两个 SFT message corpus，而不是论文中的原始真实与合成 trajectory collection。
  • 必须区分不同 judge：Llama-3.3-70B 筛选训练轨迹，GPT-4o 负责 benchmark evaluation 与 WMLA rollout scoring，真实执行则提供 environmental outcome。
  • 合成训练使用 iteration-2 world model 与 iteration-1 policy，只处理此前未成功的 query，并在最多七步后停止。
  • WMLA 最多采样三个动作，使用 temperature 0 与 0.7，模拟一至三层深度；它是 inference-time procedure，不是公开训练数据。
  • 在声称可重放或广泛复用之前，应核查逐 row lineage、rejected attempt、timestamp、browser snapshot、decontamination、checkpoint 与第三方网页内容权利。

value.html: 1,516 training queries from the Mind2Web training set and self-instructed queries for websites represented in WebVoyager and Mind2Web.

Two released JSONL SFT corpora, webevolver_policy_sft.jsonl and webevolver_world_model_sft.jsonl, serialize chat messages for policy and world-model fine-tuning; they are not a raw-trajectory release.
Llama-3.3-70B policy models generate real and synthetic actions and rationales; a co-trained Llama-3.3-70B world model generates synthetic accessibility-tree observations.
Cognitive Kernel drives a Playwright browser over live websites and represents visible page state as an accessibility tree.

Llama-3.3-70B gives binary completion judgments for rejection sampling inside self-improvement. GPT-4o supplies end-to-end benchmark judgments and WMLA rollout scores of 0, 0.5, or 1; these are distinct uses.
Real interaction ends at task completion or a step limit. Synthetic training trajectories have at most seven steps and may stop earlier when the world model emits a terminal state.
Llama-3.3-70B for the policy and world model.
The original Llama-3.3-70B base model supplies transition rationales; no stronger closed-source teacher is used inside the self-improvement loop.

Live browser rollouts train the policy and world model; the iteration-2 world model and iteration-1 policy then alternate to synthesize trajectories for queries not completed by real self-improvement rollouts.

The paper reports three self-improvement iterations. World-model augmentation uses the iteration-1 policy and iteration-2 world model; synthetic rollouts are capped at seven steps. WMLA samples up to three candidate actions and simulates depths one to three.
Per-query rollout counts and the number accepted at each iteration are unknown.
Training-time sampling temperature is unknown. For WMLA, the first action uses temperature 0 and alternative actions use temperature 0.7 plus a diversity instruction.
Llama-3.3-70B judges task completion and retains successful real and synthetic trajectories for SFT. The paper does not report calibration or human validation of these training labels.
WMLA considers up to three actions per state with look-ahead depth one to three; this inference trace is not part of the released SFT files.
Iterative supervised fine-tuning on accumulated accepted trajectories; the paper explicitly distinguishes this from end-to-end reinforcement learning.

The accepted record reports 13,465 released SFT message rows across policy and world-model data. The official Hugging Face viewer currently summarizes one train split with about 13.5k rows and exposes two JSONL files, not raw live or synthetic trajectories.

One combined train split is exposed. Row-level source, iteration, query, website, real-versus-synthetic, acceptance, timestamp, and train/evaluation-overlap mappings are not provided in a release manifest.
unknown

items: A policy-derived Llama-3.3-70B completion judge can retain false successes or reject valid alternate paths, and its calibration is not reported.
The world model can hallucinate or drift from the live website; its reported intrinsic scores fall below 0.50 at generation depths greater than two.
Live websites change, and the experiments exclude inaccessible or blocked sites, limiting exact replay and coverage.
The release omits raw trajectories, rejected rollouts, per-iteration counts, timestamps, source identifiers, replay state, and model checkpoints.

The released single messages field does not by itself expose the structured provenance needed to separate real from synthetic examples or policy from world-model construction stages without parsing content and files.
Benchmark success rates evaluate trained agents under the reported setup; they do not establish that every released SFT row or self-judgment is correct or reusable.

value.html: The Tencent repository and Hugging Face dataset declare MIT, and the ACL paper is CC BY 4.0; rights and consent for web content embedded in released message text are not documented.

Queries -> live browser trajectories -> Llama-3.3-70B completion judgment -> accepted policy SFT -> world-model transition SFT with base-model rationales -> synthetic trajectories for previously unsuccessful queries -> completion judgment -> augmented policy SFT. WMLA is a separate inference-time branch scored by GPT-4o.
